name: H6 Private Store for WooCommerce
author: Jo Cox

sections.description:
H6 Private Store for WooCommerce lets you control who can access your website or store content using simple, reliable access rules that work with any theme and the built-in WooCommerce login system.

It’s ideal for:
– Invite-only or client-only stores
– B2B and wholesale sites
– Internal company shops
– Pre-launch or private catalogs

This plugin focuses on access control and visibility — not subscriptions or recurring payments.

Restriction Modes

Choose exactly what should be private:

  • Whole site
    Hide your entire website from logged-out users.

  • Whole store
    Lock down all WooCommerce pages, including the Shop, product pages, Cart, and Checkout.

  • Selected content
    Restrict only what you need: Pages, Posts, Products, Product Categories, Product Tags, Post Categories, and Post Tags.

Restrictions are enforced at the access level, without template overrides or theme-specific workarounds.

Search & Indexing Control

Control how restricted content is handled by search engines:

  • Leave indexing behavior unchanged
  • Send an X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow header on restricted requests
  • Optionally add best-effort robots.txt rules to discourage crawling

This helps reduce the risk of private content appearing in search results, though search engine behavior cannot be guaranteed.

Works With Any Theme

H6 Private Store for WooCommerce uses:
– Native WooCommerce authentication
– Your existing theme styles

There are no templates to override, no frontend redesign, and no theme-specific configuration required.

Simple Setup

Activate the plugin, choose what to restrict, and your store becomes private immediately.

No complex configuration. No external dependencies.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/h6-private-store-for-woocommerce/, or install it via the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → H6 Private Store to configure your access rules.
sections.faq:
Does this block bots from indexing restricted content?

If enabled, the plugin sends an X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow header on restricted requests. You can also optionally add robots.txt rules to discourage crawling.

Note that search engine behavior is not guaranteed, and previously indexed content may still appear in results for some time.

Where do users log in?

Restricted users are redirected to the standard WooCommerce My Account page. The original destination URL is preserved using redirect_to, so users are returned to their intended page after logging in.

Is this a membership or subscription plugin?

No. This plugin provides access control only. It does not manage subscriptions, payments, or recurring memberships.
